meta.title: SmartUI — Conversational Components
meta.description: ChatGPT-inspired appearance, interactive tables, charts and forms in native DSH conversations. Actions fill a draft for review; they never auto-send.

ui.fallback: Interactive view unavailable. The recorded response is preserved below.
ui.failed: This UI tool failed or was interrupted. No actions are available.
ui.disabled: SmartUI components are turned off. The recorded response is preserved below.
ui.crashed: This component could not be displayed. The recorded summary is still available.
ui.copyManual: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select this text and copy it manually.
ui.chartAlternative: All values are available in the data table below.
ui.reviewFirst: Your choices only fill the native draft. Review it and press Send to continue. Do not enter passwords, API keys or other credentials.
ui.actionInvalid: The action is invalid or too large. Please check the values.
ui.validation.number: Enter a finite number between -1e12 and 1e12.
ui.validation.range: Use a number within this field's allowed range.
ui.validation.option: Choose one of the listed options.
ui.validation.length: Enter plain text, at most 8000 characters.
ui.insert.inserted: Filled into the draft. Review it and press Send; nothing has been sent yet.
ui.insert.selection: The draft contains a text selection. Deselect it first, then retry. Existing text was not replaced.
ui.insert.changed: The draft changed or became locked. Nothing was inserted; please retry.
ui.insert.unavailable: The native draft is unavailable or in command mode. Return to a normal message draft and retry.
ui.insert.tooLarge: This action exceeds the draft insertion limit. Reduce the form content.
ui.localState: Selections are local until you fill and send the draft.
ui.prompt.table: Use render_smart_ui to compare the options relevant to our current task in a table. If the options are not known, ask me first. Do not invent facts.
ui.prompt.chart: Use render_smart_ui to visualize the data from our conversation in a bar or line chart. If no data is available, ask me for it first. Do not invent values.
ui.prompt.form: Use render_smart_ui to create a short form collecting the information needed for our current task. Never ask for passwords, API keys or credentials.
ui.settings.title: SmartUI
ui.settings.description: Enhance native DSH without replacing its conversation, input or approvals. These preferences apply to this profile.
ui.settings.refused: The Host did not accept this change. The last accepted setting is shown.
ui.settings.error: The change could not be saved. Check the connection and try again.
ui.settings.unavailable: This profile does not expose SmartUI preferences or does not allow editing them.
